currentRoundInspection.scope: Four useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected west front: asymmetric warm brick westwork; southern octagonal clock drum and concave green metal spire, northern triangular gable with terracotta roof, smaller central gable, cream pointed blind-panel rhythms, central pointed entrance and two flanking lancets. Tall narrow dark windows occupy selected blind bays. Buttresses step out at the base. Lettering,clock numerals and precise tracery excluded.

Inspected elevated southwest whole-building view: very steep dark gray standing-seam roof over broader nave,continuous ridge over narrower eastern choir and roof turret;lower southern projecting strip,small roof vents and pale cornice fields. Current brick masses and green south spire retained. Trees obscure lower side details; those remain approximate.

Inspected northeast exterior: open tall rectangular red/pink stone colonnade and flat entablature shelter the tomb,attached to choir. Two tiers of paired pointed windows/pale framing and small cornice fields on choir,steep dark standing-seam roof. Backing/tomb monument inspected separately in Commons img05. Map5m colonnade tag is inconsistent with picture proportion:modeled10.4m entablature is explicitly estimated.
Inspected plain pink stone backing,pale plaque and simple pitched gray stone tomb on shallow base. No exact inscription reproduction.
